paper_id: Zhu et al. - 2014 - Context-free Attacks Using Keyboard Acoustic Emanations
title: Context-free Attacks Using Keyboard Acoustic Emanations
motivation: Context-based keystroke attacks fail on random passwords and require costly language model training
problem_framing: Geometric localization of keystrokes via TDoA, without knowing keyboard-phone relative pose
key_insight: Overlay half-hyperbola bands from multiple microphone pairs to narrow candidate key regions
method_signature: TDoA via GCC-PHAT + hyperbola band overlay + keyboard pose estimation
evaluation_criteria: 72.2% keystroke recovery rate, tested on Apple and Filco keyboards
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Assumes known keyboard layout; cannot distinguish keyboards with different key arrangements like 'fn' button
evidence_for_taste: high cost at the context learning stage
not valid in many cases, e.g., passwords
a conservative method to estimate the hyperbola band
thinking_moves: 把context-dependent问题reframe成纯几何定位问题
先证理论可行(分辨率<键距)，再设计算法
用conservative保守估计处理非理想采样误差
从信号处理角度处理reverberation而非用learning
通过maximum intersections降低枚举搜索复杂度
